params.body:
Trends now go on gentells.com by rule: live, seen at least five times on platforms, the newest at most 30 days old. A person no longer approves them, but can take one off. The Trends tab showed proposals waiting for a yes. It now shows what is on the site and what a person took off.

## What changes (`src/Site.jsx`)

- The intro states the rules.
- **Online N** lists each trend with:
  - how often and when it was last seen;
  - the posts that cite it;
  - a View link;
  - **Take off**, which hides the trend.
- **Taken off N** lists each hidden trend with **Put back**.
- The pending list and its toast are gone.

## Tests

`npm test`: 62 of 62. `npm run build` passes.
params.title: Trends tab: online by rule, taken off by a person
